newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian border guards kill four Tajik fighters.
newsitem.headline: Russian border guards kill four Tajik fighters.

text.p: Russia's border guards said on Saturday they killed four Tajik opposition fighters and wounded two more during an attack on a Russian military bus in the capital Dushanbe the previous night.

Gunmen, who the border guards's press service said belonged to Tajikistan's Islamist opposition, opened fire with grenade launchers and automatic rifles on the bus carrying Russian soldiers, killing two and wounding six.
The spokesman for Tajik President Imomali Rakhmonov, Zafar Sayidov, said the attack was carried out by "irreconciable elements of the (Tajik) opposition".
On Wednesday, another group of gunmen fired on a bus in Dushanbe, seriously wounding two Russian servicemen.
Thousands of Russian troops guard the remote, former Soviet republic's border with Afghanistan and fulfil peacekeeping duties there.
Civil war has raged for four years in the mountainous country between Tajik government forces and the Islamic opposition.
Dozens of Russian soldiers in Dushanbe have been killed and injured in attacks blamed on the opposition.
